about: One row per (owner model, bulletId). bulletIds are the bullet_<id> FSMs in the player's dt_actionset_statue_<psid>; the owner model comes from the BLETList (bullet launch) events in frameevents_statue_battle_<psid> when listed there, otherwise every model of that statue. ownerModelIdHash = String.GetHashCode(model name). The tactical battle builds one pool per row (CreateBulletPool) and kills a launched bullet at once when its row is missing. Frame-event ids 0 = GameConst.InvalidFrameEventId (no bullet effect).
